handoffs.message: Implementation complete. Deliverables: (1) cloudbuild.yaml — Cloud Build config with per-service conditional build loop, SHA+env-tag push to Artifact Registry, best-effort build manifest to GCS. (2) .github/workflows/gcp-deploy.yml — replaced long-lived GCP_SA_KEY with OIDC/WIF using google-github-actions/auth workload_identity_provider + service_account; submits to Cloud Build via gcloud builds submit with changed-path-detected _SERVICES substitution. (3) Pantheon_GCP_GitHub_Docker_正式部署與環境設計_v2.md Section 19 — WIF setup commands, image naming/tag strategy, changed-path gating, provenance, acceptance mapping. Both acceptance criteria satisfied: single repo-to-build-to-image path wired, no long-lived key in GitHub.

Review found blocking ID-mapping issues between Stage 0 build_ids and cloudbuild.yaml. See .orchestrator/reviews/BP5-CICD-002-codex2-review.md and realign the Cloud Build service inventory before re-review.

All blocking ID-mapping issues resolved. Changes: (1) cloudbuild.yaml service registry now uses Stage 0 matrix IDs verbatim — bff (was operator-bff), governance-api (was governance), telemetry-ingest (was telemetry); (2) added 9 missing research/execution-lab images; (3) runtime-manager path corrected; (4) Section 19.5 updated with service inventory table and manual-only distinction. Please re-review.
Re-review passed. Stage 0 build IDs, Cloud Build service registry, and Section 19 inventory are aligned; owner can finalize closeout.
